description: Land Acquisition - Pitabeddara, Pitabeddara D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that specific lands (Thannahena Estate) are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired. It contains detailed descriptions of the land parcels, including their extent, boundaries, and location. This falls squarely under Type 4 (Land Gazettes) for land and property-related matters, specifically land acquisitions.
